review_candidates.title: PCBA Quality Engineer
review_candidates.description: Location: Mahachai, Thailand Core Responsibility: Own quality across the PCBA production process at the customer's contract manufacturer, including surface mount (SMT), wave soldering, and in-circuit test (ICT), for electronics that must operate reliably outdoors for years. Own quality across the SMT lines, from solder paste printing through placement and reflow, ensuring process control plans reflect what actually drives quality and are followed on every build. Own quality across the wave soldering process, including pallet design, flux and preheat control, and through-hole solder joint quality. Implement and monitor statistical process control (SPC) on critical process parameters, acting on drift before it becomes a yield or field problem. Hold PCBA workmanship to the IPC-A-610 standard at the appropriate class and ensure the contract manufacturer applies it consistently. Own the defect detection strategy across the PCBA process, including SPI, AOI, and X-ray, with coverage designed around real failure modes rather than default machine programs. Own quality of the ICT stage, including coverage, fixture health, and discipline around retest and failure disposition. Lead root cause analysis on PCBA failures from production, test, and the field, selecting the right analysis techniques and determining whether the cause is the process, the design, or the component. Collaborate with the customer's hardware design, test engineering, and failure analysis teams in Auckland, New Zealand, and with its Supplier Quality team when a failure traces back to a component. Own the quality side of any change affecting the PCBA, including new board revisions, component changes, line moves, and process changes, defining first article and validation requirements based on risk. Key Deliverables: SMT and wave soldering processes that are demonstrably in control, with effective control plans and SPC on the parameters that matter. Consistent IPC-A-610 workmanship across all builds. SPI, AOI, X-ray, and ICT coverage that catches the defects that matter, with every escape closed by fixing both the process and the detection gap that missed it. Build-over-build improvement in PCBA first pass yield, driven by Pareto analysis of the largest defect contributors. Root cause identified and sustainable corrective actions implemented for production, test, and field failures. Improved correlation between production test results and field performance, closing gaps where boards pass test but fail in use. Design for manufacturability (DFM) feedback that lands in the next board revision. Risk-based first article and validation completed before any PCBA change is released to production. Minimum Qualifications Bachelor's degree in Electrical/Electronics Engineering, Materials Engineering, Manufacturing Engineering, or a related field. 5+ years of PCBA quality engineering experience in high-volume electronics manufacturing, spanning SMT, wave soldering, and in-circuit test. Deep knowledge of SMT and wave soldering processes and their failure modes: paste, placement, reflow, flux and preheat, and the solder joint defects that follow when any of them drift. Working fluency with IPC-A-610 and related workmanship standards, with experience applying them in production. Hands-on failure analysis capability, including knowing which analysis techniques to use for a given failure mode and following the evidence to the true root cause. Strong statistical process control experience, including setting up SPC on critical parameters and acting on the data. Experience providing DFM feedback to design teams and seeing it implemented in the next revision. Comfortable working on the production floor each day; low ego and willing to raise difficult issues early. Fluent Thai and excellent verbal and written English communication skills. Experience working with a U.S. or global technology company is highly preferred. Willingness to travel as required.

What began as an idea in 2022 is today a rapidly growing DTC subscription model serving over 20,000 dogs. Our 15-person team is set to grow to over 35 by the end of 2026 – now is the perfect time to join. We don’t believe in off-the-shelf products. We develop nutritional solutions for dogs that have real impact, for the dogs and for their owners. Products like that don’t just convince logically, they inspire emotionally and turn first-time buyers into true fans. Great products need great stories. That’s why we’re building our video ad team in-house: a team that makes people feel what our products mean for their dogs, and that is fast, creative, and driven by data. As Team Lead Video Ad Editor, you’ll lead that team and set its standard. Your role You lead and coach our video editing team (one junior and one mid-level editor) so that together you produce top-performing ads, on time and at a high level. You report to the Director of Performance Marketing and stay hands-on as an editor yourself. You coach the team to create ads that perform, following current trends and getting faster over time. That’s the standard for everything you do. You set up the team’s workflow and the tools and processes that power it (templates, naming conventions, review loops, AI-assisted workflows) to boost output, speed, and quality, and you prioritize briefs together with the performance marketing team. You edit short-form, direct-response video ads for Meta yourself, built on strong hooks, visual storytelling, and well-placed text, sound, and design. You turn performance briefs, concepts, and raw material (UGC, brand, native) into ads that capture and convince new customers. You use data (hook rate, VTR, CTR, CVR) to decide what to iterate on next, and teach your team to read and apply these insights. You keep an eye on ad, creative, and platform trends and bring best practices from the DACH region and international markets into the team’s work. Getting in front of the camera yourself is a plus, as is organizing small shoots or UGC setups to test new ideas quickly. Your profile Must-haves At least 4 years of experience editing paid social video creatives (Meta, TikTok is a plus) in e-commerce or D2C, with a clear direct-response focus. Close day-to-day work with performance marketing or media buying teams, and a solid understanding of how creative performance is measured. First leadership experience, formal or informal, such as mentoring junior editors, reviewing the team's work, or owning a creative workflow. You don’t need extensive years of people management, but you want to grow into the role and should own the team's output. Experience with UGC, brand, and native formats, and a strong sense of visual storytelling, pacing, sound, design, and copy. Understanding of performance KPIs (hook rate, VTR, CTR, CVR) and the drive to turn insights straight into new iterations. Proficiency in Adobe Premiere, After Effects, CapCut, DaVinci Resolve, or similar tools. Very good German and good English (at least B2) for working with our target audiences. Benefits ⏰ Flexibility that fits you: Whether in our office in Frankfurt am Main or on your hybrid days in your own homeoffice in Germany – find a rhythm that works for you 💡Lots of responsibility and creative freedom: You get real ownership areas – and the chance to actively shape the role with your input and pace 📈Fast development possible: Those who step on the gas with us grow along – in responsibility, competence and perspective 💬 Open and honest communication: We live direct exchange, give clear feedback and look forward to your input 📚 Individual training budget: We invest in your personal and professional development – because your growth is also our growth 🎟 Access to Corporate Benefits and Wellpass: So you can do something good for yourself outside of work too 🐶 Free HEY HOLY food: Because happy dogs are just as important as happy people! 🎉 28 Vacation Days + Christmas Eve and New Year's on us Closing Statement: We value Diversity! 🌈 We believe in the power of different perspectives and seek team members regardless of how they look, where they come from, whom they love, or what they believe. What counts for us are your skills – and your willingness to not only grow yourself, but also support others in their development. Because only together are we truly strong! 🫶 Our mission is clear: We want to grow to enable as many dogs as possible to have a better life. For this, we need people with different experiences, perspectives and strengths. Because we're convinced that teams with diverse, complementary abilities are the most successful 💡🚀 Read our full JEDI commitment statement on our website.

review_candidates.description: Company Description Paradigm Energy is a renewable energy company focused on delivering solar solutions that help individuals and organizations transition to a sustainable future. Founded in 2020, the company is dedicated to transforming how the world harnesses energy by promoting cleaner, greener alternatives. Paradigm Energy leverages cutting-edge technology and stringent quality standards to design and implement efficient solar systems. With a strong customer-centric approach, the organization aims to build long-term partnerships and create meaningful environmental impact. Team members join a mission-driven environment that values innovation, reliability, and sustainable growth. Role Description The Lead Project Engineer is a full-time, on-site role based in Karachi Division, responsible for overseeing the engineering and execution of solar energy projects from concept through commissioning. Day-to-day activities include leading project design, performing technical evaluations, and ensuring compliance with relevant electrical and safety standards. The role involves coordinating project planning, scheduling, and resource allocation in collaboration with project managers and cross-functional teams. The Lead Project Engineer will review engineering drawings, supervise installations, conduct site inspections, and resolve technical issues to keep projects on time and within budget. This position also requires mentoring junior engineers, preparing project documentation and reports, and maintaining clear communication with stakeholders, vendors, and clients throughout the project lifecycle. Qualifications Candidates should possess strong Project Engineering and Electrical Engineering skills, with experience in solar or power systems preferred. Candidates should possess solid Project Management and Project Planning skills, including budgeting, scheduling, risk management, and coordination of multidisciplinary teams. Candidates should possess effective Communication skills, with the ability to convey technical information clearly to technical and non-technical stakeholders. Relevant bachelor’s degree in Electrical Engineering or a related engineering discipline; advanced degrees or professional certifications (e.g., PMP, PEC registration) are an advantage. Proven experience leading complex engineering projects, ideally in renewable energy, with a track record of successful on-site execution. Proficiency with engineering and design software (e.g., AutoCAD, PV design tools) and familiarity with local and international electrical codes and standards. Strong analytical, problem-solving, and decision-making abilities, with attention to safety, quality, and continuous improvement.

We're one global team driven by our common purpose to deliver a better world. Join us. Job Description AECOM's Enterprise Capabilities team is looking for a Junior Civil Engineer to join our team in China. Operating across geographic boundaries and time-zones, EC partners with regional and Global Business Line project teams to provide technical expertise, accelerate delivery and keep AECOM competitive in the industry. With a team of over 3000 technical professionals located across nine countries and remote technical anchors, EC teams are trusted to deliver high-quality, specialist services that help to fill capability gaps, resourcing needs and technical constraints on projects of all scopes and sizes. Responsibilities Assisting experienced Engineers with calculations, analysis, and design relating to the design of various highway/bridge/underway station components. 协助有经验的工程师完成各种公路/桥梁/地铁站等项目相关的计算、分析和设计工作。 Create and evaluate design responses based on outline briefs, accurately analyze data, and successfully interact with others. 根据大纲概要创建和评估设计响应，准确分析数据，并成功与他人互动。 Examine intricate drawings and design and assessment calculations. 检查复杂的图纸以及设计和评估计算。 Ensure that the project is delivered in compliance with quality standards, timelines, and budget. 确保项目的交付符合质量标准、时间表和预算。 Create designs, calculations, specs, and drawings to make sure technical designs offer the right solution. 创建设计、计算、规格和图纸，以确保技术设计提供正确的解决方案。 Keep track of all design calculations, drawings, and papers. 跟踪所有设计计算、图纸和文件 As needed, maintain contacts with clients and establish new ones. 根据需要，与客户保持联系并建立新的联系。 Qualifications Bachelor’s degree or above in civil engineering or bridge engineering; 土木工程或者桥梁工程本科及以上学历； 0 to 3 years of experience in civil engineering or bridge projects. 0～3年土木工程或桥梁项目经验； Have clear concepts and design capabilities, and strong summary and comprehension abilities. 具备清晰的概念、设计能力，较强的总结和领悟能力； Proficient in using Midas Civil, SAP2000, CAD and Microsoft office. 熟练应用Midas Civil、SAP2000、CAD及Microsoft office； Strong sense of responsibility and teamwork. 责任心强，具备团队合作精神； Fluent written and spoken English capabilities; 流利的英语书面和口语能力 Additional Information Please upload your resume and transcripts (both Bachelor's and Master's) when applying. review_candidates.title: Integrated Marketing Manager - EMEA
review_candidates.description: This position is listed on behalf of a partner company, who manages all applications and next steps. Our partner is looking for an Integrated Marketing Manager - EMEA based in Germany. We are seeking an experienced Integrated Marketing Manager to lead regional marketing strategy and execution across Europe, with a focus on Aerospace & Defense manufacturing and Maintenance, Repair & Overhaul (MRO) markets. In this role, you will drive brand awareness, generate qualified leads, and contribute directly to regional pipeline growth through integrated marketing campaigns and strategic initiatives. You will adapt global marketing strategies to local market needs, developing relevant content, events, and account-based marketing programs. Working closely with Business Development, Sales, Product Marketing, and global marketing teams, you will ensure consistent messaging and effective campaign execution across multiple European markets. You will take ownership of regional planning, budgets, performance measurement, and marketing partnerships. This is a hands-on opportunity to shape regional market presence and deliver measurable commercial impact within an international B2B technology environment. Accountabilities Develop and own the EMEA marketing strategy, including quarterly plans and campaign calendars aligned with global marketing priorities, regional business objectives, target accounts, and commercial opportunities. Translate global campaigns, product launches, and customer success stories into locally relevant marketing programs tailored to European markets. Identify regional investment opportunities and recommend adjustments to global marketing strategies based on market maturity, language, regulatory requirements, and local commercial conditions. Lead regional brand awareness initiatives by defining target audiences, priority markets, and measurable objectives in collaboration with Global Marketing. Strengthen brand visibility among European Aerospace & Defense manufacturing and MRO audiences through industry events, speaking opportunities, public relations, analyst engagement, social media, and partner channels. Adapt global brand messaging and positioning to local languages and market requirements while ensuring consistency, accuracy, and compliance with approved communications. Coordinate with Marketing Operations to monitor brand awareness indicators, including branded search activity, regional website traffic, event reach, and speaking engagement performance. Manage the regional execution of integrated marketing campaigns, working with Content Marketing, Customer Marketing, and Product Marketing to develop localized assets, customer case studies, and thought leadership materials. Plan and oversee European paid media and lead generation programs, managing external partners, audience targeting, lead quality, and follow-up processes. Leverage AI-powered tools to improve market research, campaign insights, marketing briefs, and localized content production, ensuring appropriate human review for technical accuracy and approved messaging. Lead EMEA field marketing and event initiatives, including major industry events such as the Paris Air Show, Farnborough International Airshow, MRO Europe, and Aviation Forum. Manage the full event lifecycle, including booth planning, speaking opportunities, pre-booked meetings, on-site engagement, post-event follow-up, and cost-per-lead performance. Prepare comprehensive event briefs for Sales and Business Development teams, defining target audiences, key messages, product demonstrations, and meeting objectives. Evaluate regional event opportunities and allocate investments based on their potential contribution to qualified leads and sales pipeline. Partner with EMEA Business Development to define target accounts and develop account-based marketing (ABM) and digital marketing strategies. Coordinate personalized marketing initiatives for strategic accounts, including dedicated landing pages, targeted advertising, and tailored outreach campaigns. Ensure timely lead handovers and close collaboration with Business Development teams to support same-business-day follow-up. Monitor and report regional marketing performance, including Marketing Qualified Leads (MQLs), meetings, pipeline contribution, conversion rates, account engagement, and campaign effectiveness. Track paid media and event acquisition costs, assess performance against agreed targets, and continuously optimize marketing investments. Establish regional performance baselines and provide monthly reporting on EMEA-sourced and EMEA-influenced pipeline, campaign outcomes, and key learnings. Work cross-functionally with Sales, Business Development, Field Marketing, Content, Customer Marketing, Product Marketing, Digital Operations, and Competitive Intelligence teams to ensure effective regional execution. Deliver key initial priorities within the first 90 days, including an agreed EMEA marketing plan and calendar, regional event briefs, a defined target account tier, and baseline lead and pipeline measurements. Requirements At least 5 years of experience leading B2B marketing or go-to-market initiatives across multiple EMEA markets, ideally within enterprise software or technology environments involving complex purchasing processes. Previous experience in Aerospace & Defense, manufacturing, or Maintenance, Repair & Overhaul (MRO) software markets is strongly preferred. Proven ability to develop and execute regional marketing strategies that align global business objectives with local market requirements. Demonstrated track record of delivering measurable commercial results through marketing, including qualified lead generation, pipeline contribution, and revenue growth. Strong strategic thinking and commercial judgment, with the ability to influence senior stakeholders and independently manage priorities in a dynamic environment. Hands-on expertise in audience segmentation, market positioning, integrated campaign development, channel planning, and demand generation. Experience planning and managing industry events, field marketing initiatives, and regional brand awareness programs. Knowledge of account-based marketing strategies and experience supporting named enterprise accounts through personalized campaigns and digital initiatives. Previous experience managing external marketing agencies, lead generation partners, budgets, and regional marketing investments. Experience working within global-regional organizational structures, adapting international campaigns to local markets while maintaining consistent brand positioning. Strong analytical skills and the ability to interpret marketing performance data, measure campaign effectiveness, and communicate business impact through clear reporting. Practical experience using AI tools to improve research, generate insights, develop marketing briefs, and support content localization, combined with sound judgment when reviewing AI-generated outputs. Hands-on experience with Salesforce and HubSpot for CRM management, campaign tracking, and lead management. Familiarity with account-based marketing platforms and tools such as Demandbase is an advantage. Ability to operate effectively in regulated industries, with an understanding of the importance of accurate technical messaging, approved claims, and compliance requirements. Fluency in both French and English is required, while German language skills are considered a strong advantage. Excellent communication, project management, and stakeholder collaboration skills, with the ability to coordinate multiple initiatives and deliver results within established timelines. Benefits Employment type: Full-time opportunity. Work arrangement: Fully remote position, with opportunities across eligible European locations. International exposure: Collaborate with global marketing teams and regional stakeholders across multiple European markets. Strategic ownership: Lead regional marketing planning and influence how the organization builds brand awareness and generates business opportunities across EMEA. Commercial impact: Directly contribute to lead generation, account engagement, pipeline development, and regional revenue growth. Industry specialization: Gain exposure to the Aerospace & Defense, manufacturing, and MRO technology sectors. Cross-functional collaboration: Work closely with Business Development, Sales, Product Marketing, Content, and global marketing specialists. Technology and innovation: Use modern marketing platforms, account-based marketing tools, and AI-powered solutions to optimize campaign performance. Professional development: Expand your expertise in international B2B marketing, enterprise demand generation, and strategic account development. Position Summary Reporting to the Clinical Manager of Geriatrics, your goal in this position is to be responsible for providing expert clinical assessment and for making recommendations regarding the health care needs of the geriatric population in our Emergency Department (ED). You will work collaboratively with other Geriatric Emergency Management (GEM) nurses across the province, as well as liaising with other hospitals, the community and retirement home services in our region to build the province’s capacity to deliver more effective emergency services for our geriatric population. You are able to work independently and collaboratively with all members of the health-care team including patients and families. You have a strong knowledge of community resources and can apply principles of patient and family centered care. You demonstrate exceptional skills in performing assessments, health promotion and health teaching for the older adult population. You use critical thinking, problem-solving, and decision-making to provide the most appropriate safety plans for your patient. You have excellent communication and interpersonal skills. Primary Responsibilities Complete comprehensive assessments and identify the needs of elderly patients in the ED, with the goal of avoiding unnecessary hospitalizations and to safely discharge patients to the community. Act as a resource/coach to ED staff in the care and management of elderly patients with complex medical and social issues. Participate in program evaluation and ongoing ED quality improvement initiatives. Work collaboratively with ED dementia team to facilitate timely and safe discharge of elderly patients from the ED and to link them to community resources including Specialized Geriatric services (SGS). Work collaboratively with in-patient geriatrics team as required to ensure comprehensive care to identified high risk geriatric patients. Communicate assessment findings and needs of admitted patients to members of the receiving unit’s interdisciplinary team. Initiate and maintain links with other GEM Nurses in the HNHBB Region to advance clinical outcomes for older adults receiving care in the ED. Analyze and interpret best evidence related to care of older adults. Design and provide educational and learning opportunities for staff and acts as a resource for related issues and problem solving. Promote a model of best practice in Elder Care nursing and an elder friendly philosophy of care within the ED. Build relationships with the local retirement homes within the community to build capacity and collaboration with the goal being ED avoidance.
